newsitem.title: USA: Apple names chief information officer.
newsitem.headline: Apple names chief information officer.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said Tuesday Joseph Riera has been appointed to the newly created position of chief information officer, Information Systems and Technology (IS&T), effective immediately.
Riera, who was formerly vice president, IS&T, will report to Fred Anderson, Apple's executive vice president and chief financial officer, the company said.

In his new role, Riera will be responsible for overseeing Apple's worldwide information systems, including application software development, networking, communications, and computer center operations. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
